# PDF Search Benchmark Queries
# Test queries for validating PDF extraction search quality
# Target: >80% success rate (at least one top-3 result correctly answers query)

## Broad Topic Queries (General Search)
travel expenses
vehicle deductions
business income
advertising costs
home office expenses
insurance deductions
professional fees
office supplies
utilities costs

## Specific Filtered Queries (Requires expense_type classification)
meal expense for business sole proprietor
travel expenses for farming business
vehicle lease deduction rules
home office deduction for self-employed

## Edge Cases & Complex Queries
can I deduct my car lease
what percentage of meals can I deduct
GST/HST requirements for businesses
capital cost allowance rules
inventory valuation methods

## Expected to Fail (Tests Missing Features)
meal expenses in BC
farming expenses in Quebec
